original_mechanism: Perry Kaufman Adaptive Moving Average efficiency ratio; StockCharts ChartSchool standard KAMA(10,2,30) + KAMA(10,5,30) longer smoothing filter example

evidence.claim: ER(10), smoothing = [ER*(2/(fast+1)-2/(slow+1))+2/(slow+1)]^2; slope of slower KAMA and price crossing faster KAMA as example
Full DataFrame leakage and lookahead checks

strategy.entry_after_completed_bar: If close[t-1]<=KAMAfast[t-1], close[t]>KAMAfast[t], and KAMAslow[t]>KAMAslow[t-1], enter at next 1h bar OPEN in modelled development
strategy.exit_after_completed_bar: If close[t]<KAMAfast[t] OR KAMAslow[t]<=KAMAslow[t-1], exit at next 1h bar OPEN; never same close/intrabar
strategy.kama_initial_seed: SMA of first 10 closes at index 9; KAMA recurrence begins index 10
strategy.entry_competing_position: max 1 open position per symbol, no pyramiding and no overlapping same-symbol
strategy.end_of_partition: unresolved open positions censored and excluded from closed-only profit, optionally labelled MTM diagnostic
strategy.equity_account: strategy trade-bps only, no NAV or position-size profit

comparator: predeclared standard fastEMA20 slowEMA50 slope-and-price-cross at same timeframe with identical next open fill and cost; diagnostic only

costs.source: original frozen programme modeled costs, actual fee/funding/slippage unbound

fail_criteria: Reject/retire if 2x validation Net<=0, validation PF<=1, unacceptable DD/long losing streak/top2 concentration, or unacceptable retained count; no tuning on same history
